name: Dive Team Interns
what_you_do: A paid summer internship about ocean science and SCUBA. You learn diving basics in practice sessions, try one open water dive, meet marine science workers and help museum guests.
who_can_apply: Rising juniors and seniors. You need a 2.0 GPA or higher. You must go to one of three schools: Math, Science, and Technology Magnet Academy, Roosevelt High School or Mendez High School. You must be at ease in the water. You must be allowed to work in the US.
duration: 6 weeks, full time on weekdays, 35 hours a week (June 15 to July 31 last summer)
deadline_text: Closed for Summer 2026. The page did not post application dates. Summer 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply on the program page when it opens. The page says the program is competitive. You need a work permit from your high school if you are hired.
notes: Only students at three Los Angeles high schools can apply. Paid for by a gift from the Vera R. Campbell Foundation. The page lists no minimum age.
